entry.alt: Interpretive watercolor for Bhagavad Gītā 15.1: Śrī Bhagavān said: They speak of an eternal Aśvattha tree with roots above and branches below, whose leaves are the Vedic hymns. One who knows this tree is a knower of the Vedas.
